triggerCases.prompt: Take a screenshot of the expanded menu for this PR at 320px wide.
Save a PNG of the Button's dark-mode Storybook example.
Capture before and after images of this layout fix in the local app.
Explain the error message in this attached screenshot.
Run the existing Storybook interaction tests for Button and report failures.
Review this React component PR and give me actionable findings.

outputCases.prompt: Capture the requested expanded menu screenshot and return the saved image.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A readable viewport capture of the expanded popup from the correct local story, with no redundant story discovery or external writes.
assertions: The workflow reuses the matching tab and running server after verifying their source, and skips Storybook queries because the URL is known.
The viewport is set to 320 by 640 before the menu is expanded through a supported interaction.
The capture includes the popup rendered outside the trigger container instead of cropping it with a trigger-element screenshot.
The workflow saves to an absolute path, inspects the image, and delivers an expanded-state image rather than the collapsed initial image.
The response identifies the story, source revision, viewport, and state without claiming integrated-app or accessibility-test coverage.
No screenshot after every interaction, extra theme matrix, upload, comment, or PR-description write occurs.

outputCases.prompt: Find the existing dark-mode Button story and save the requested screenshot.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: Storybook resolves the story and Chrome saves an inspected image after its font and interaction state are ready.
assertions: Storybook MCP resolves the existing story URL; the workflow does not invent a story ID or treat the preview link as a saved PNG.
Chrome DevTools MCP captures the story using its exposed schema after the font loads and the story interaction finishes.
The workflow inspects and delivers the saved PNG without creating a new story, editing source, running unrelated tests, or uploading the image.

outputCases.prompt: Capture the settings dialog with its validation error visible using the available tools.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A structured browser capture through the computer-use tool without attempted MCP installation or desktop coordinate navigation.
assertions: The workflow recognizes that configured but unexposed Chrome tools are unavailable and uses the documented structured browser API.
Semantic browser interactions reveal the error, and the inspected capture includes the dialog and validation message.
The workflow does not install MCP servers or addons, change global configuration, or use desktop coordinate clicks for this reachable browser UI.
The response reports the actual capture route without claiming measured speed improvements.

outputCases.prompt: Capture the requested before and after comparison without disturbing unrelated work.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: Two inspected integrated-app screenshots from verified revisions with matching conditions and preserved unrelated work.
assertions: The baseline and changed captures use verified separate revisions and avoid the stale hosted Storybook preview.
Both captures match viewport, scale, light theme, data, scroll position, and expanded-menu state.
Baseline setup preserves the unrelated uncommitted work; no reset or cleanup discards it.
Both saved images are inspected and labeled with their revision, route, viewport, and state, with no external upload or GitHub write.
